hero.title: Befriending your anxiety
hero.description: Simple exercises to welcome anxiety when it shows up, let it pass and find a little calm again. No equipment needed: use them whenever you feel the need.

install.title: Install Ma boussole
install.text: Add the site to your home screen to open it like an app, even offline.
iosSteps: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen (at the top on iPad).
Scroll down and tap 'Add to Home Screen'.
Tap 'Add' in the top right corner.
install.iosNote: Using Safari. In another browser, first open the site in Safari.
androidSteps: Open your browser menu (⋮ at the top right, or ≡ at the bottom).
Tap 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
Confirm: the icon appears on your home screen.
